purpose: Host-level cgroup reallocator (Component B). Reads order files written by s3_anticipation (Component A, LXC 101), independently validates them from host-visible sources, and actuates via systemctl set-property --runtime on LXC 112 clima zone units. Design per component_b_host_reallocator.spec.vsm.

algedonic.via: shared filesystem bind-mount to algedonic ledger path

safety.design_invariant: INV-SUM: Σ zone weights = 800 before every actuation, independently verified from host cgroup view
safety.r1_independent_validation: B re-derives every check from sources independent of Component A's order file
safety.self_heal: If second actuation call fails after first succeeds, B reverts the first call within the same cycle
